identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate D-0502 in Subjects With ER+ Her2- Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Parallel-controlled, Open-label, Multicenter Phase III Clinical Study to Compare the Efficacy and Safety of D-0502 With Fulvestrant in Patients With Previously Treated ER-positive, HER2-negative Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a randomized, parallel-controlled, open-label, multicenter clinical study to assess the efficacy and safety of D-0502 in the treatment of subjects with ER-positive, HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer with fulvestrant injection as a control drug.

interventions.name: D-0502
interventions.description:
* Dosage form: Tablet
* Administration route: Oral, once a day

interventions.name: Fulvestrant
interventions.description:
* Dosage form: Injection
* Administration route: Intramuscular injection, once a month, and another dose administered two weeks after the first dose
